study: CICLO_LIVELLI: il ciclo tra i livelli (gruppo di rinormalizzazione automatico)

fase1.title: Fase 1: misurare la mappa (quanto cambia la regola imparata da un livello all'altro) + registro delle influenze

method.scalar_generator: 3-D: g_j = (G_00 + G_11)/2 of the learned generator (spin part 1e-10); 1-D: positive-band eigenphase of the learned one-step kernel, G(kappa) = -(phase(kappa) - phase(0))
method.moments: 3-D exact stencil moments: c2 = -1/2 sum g_j j_x^2; c4 = 1/24 sum g_j j_x^4; c_xxyy = 1/4 sum g_j j_x^2 j_y^2 (coefficient of kappa_x^2 kappa_y^2); averaged over the 3 axes / 3 planes. 1-D: least squares of G(kappa) on kappa^2, kappa^4, kappa^6 for 0 < kappa <= min(0.3 m h, 0.8) (the A1 fit window).
method.normalized_shape: S_n(kappa) = G_n(kappa)/c2_n (rest phase removed). Schroedinger fixed point: S* = kappa^2. D_n = max_{0<kappa<=pi/2} |S_n - kappa^2| / (pi/2)^2 (1-D: axis; 3-D: axis and body diagonal). Continuum prediction D_cont(h) = max |2 h^2 (sqrt(1 + kappa^2/h^2) - 1) - kappa^2| / (pi/2)^2.
method.free_levels: levels whose c2/c4 were NOT constrained: 1-D ladder, 1-D auto, 3-D A, proton chain
method.slope: least squares slope of log|c4/c2| against log h over ALL free levels of a chain (no level dropped)

P1a.what: kinetic term marginal (z = 2 fixed point): m_kin/m = 1/(2 h c2) at every free level of every chain within 1e-3 of the fine rule's own tan(theta)/theta

P1b.what: relativistic k^4 term irrelevant with exponent y = -2: per chain (1-D ladder, 1-D auto, 3-D A, proton) slope of log|c4/c2| vs log h within -2 +- 0.1
P1b.prediction: PASS (1-D auto may be pulled by B = 384)

P1c.what: the irrelevant k^4 term comes out ISOTROPIC (rotations emerge on the cubic lattice): 3-D A free levels c_xxyy / c_xxxx in [1.8, 2.2] (continuum Dirac: 2; a separable cubic artefact: 0)
P1c.prediction: PASS at B = 16 and 256; B = 512 uncertain (k^4 is 1e-6 of k^2 there)

P1d.what: field-coupling corrections (Darwin gk, field-motion gx, spin-orbit gso) have the SAME coefficient at B = 256, 512, 1024 within 2 % (relative spread) => their weight relative to the Coulomb term at the cell scale scales as h^-2 (y = -2.00 +- 0.03 by a log fit)

P1e.what: the map flows to a fixed form: along the 1-D ladder and the 1-D auto chain D_n decreases at every level, and for h >= 2 lambda_C D_n is within 25 % of D_cont(h_n)

reported_not_judged: successive distance between normalized maps d_{n,n+1} = max |S_n - S_{n+1}| / (pi/2)^2 and its ratio per level
the analytic fixed-point stencil of S* = kappa^2 on the coarse lattice: g*_0 = pi^2/3, g*_j = 2(-1)^j / j^2 per axis (separable, long range ~ 1/j^2), compared with the learned normalized stencils
T-level, chain-B and aggmol B = 1024 numbers (constrained or too few levels)
influence ledger (table + figure): weight of each term relative to the dominant one per scale, exponent y (measured where the engine has the term, analytic otherwise, marked)

gravity: weight G m_p^2 / e^2 = 8.1e-37 per proton pair at the atom level; exponent +2 with the size of a neutral body (energy per particle ~ G M m / R ~ R^2 against a constant cohesive energy); crossover radius R_x = sqrt(3 eps v / (4 pi G (A m_p)^2)) computed for the engine's own solid H2 (eps, v from aggmol phase 3) and, for comparison only, with exam-only cohesive energies; the roundness radius needs the yield/cohesion fraction f_y, NOT derivable in the engine today (declared debt): R_round = sqrt(f_y) R_x

fase2.title: Fase 2: variabili grosse automatiche + fattore di blocco 2 / 3 / phi (Fibonacci)

config_1d.base: B0 = 32 fine cells (1.6 lambda_C), C = 1, real even stencil w = 8, G(0) = 0 and c2 exact (constraints), weights 1 (|kappa| <= pi/2), 0.03 beyond

schemes.fib: Fibonacci blocks (A <- AB, B <- A), 2584 base cells (F_18), mean factor phi per level

config_1d.loop: variables: block density matrix of the slow set (>= 12 coarse cells per wavelength), C = fewest numbers (1..2) that pass; sector = the n C modes best captured; rule: Hermitian generator tied by local pattern of block types, |j| <= w, w = smallest in 1..8 that passes; relative least squares (floor 1e-2 of the check scale), fast modes weight 0.03; check: lowest max(9, #modes with >= 24 cells/wavelength) eigenvalues vs the level below, budget 1e-3 of the check kinetic scale, captured weight of the check set >= 0.98; repeat from the LEARNED rule; stop when the next level has < 48 cells
config_1d.observables: free: base eigenvalues with kappa_base <= 2 pi 4 / 2048 (9 / 9 / 11 modes), accumulated error max|d omega| / (range); coulomb: soft Coulomb V = -g/sqrt(x^2 + s^2), g = 0.015, s = 10 lambda_C, base V = block mean of the fine V, coarse V = Galerkin W V W^dag; 3 lowest bound states (binding energies) against the exact base
config_1d.fine_anchor: bound states of the fine zig-zag (N = 32 x 2048 fine cells, sparse shift-invert) vs the base

config_3d.start: existing chain-A level B = 16 (lab/out/agg_zz_3d_A.pkl, scalar part; spin part 1e-10)
config_3d.schemes: B_{n+1} = b B_n with b = 2, 3, phi (phi: non-integer rescaling, possible in k-space because the generator is transported as b G(kappa / b); NO quasi-periodic structure in 3-D: declared)
config_3d.learn: real even stencil, cube |j|_inf <= w, w = smallest in 1..5 that passes; samples 75 % like the 1s (k_s = alpha m) + 25 % uniform with weight 0.03, relative least squares; G(0) = 0 and the axis c2 transported exactly from the level below (phase-1 lesson)
config_3d.check: energy error weighted by the 1s momentum density vs the level below <= 3e-4; bz_rel90 <= 0.2; no negative motion energy (<= 1 %) -- the chain-A budgets
config_3d.observables: accumulated error vs the fine walk's exact positive band; 1s energy shift at first order dE = <(G - G_fine)/tau>_1s relative to E_1s = alpha^2/2; chain until B >= 600

A1.what: 1-D: at every admitted level of every scheme the automatic block variables lie in the hand descriptor subspace (block mean of the large component / of the level-below amplitude): overlap >= 0.99; C = 1 everywhere

A2.what: 3-D: the 2 leading eigenvectors of the positive-band projector of the fine walk averaged over the 1s momentum density span the large component (L + R)/sqrt 2 (x) spin: overlap >= 0.999 (the machine rediscovers 'pauli2' without being told)

A3.what: 1-D free, periodic b = 2 and b = 3: every level admitted down to the stop, last B >= 27, accumulated error at the last level <= 1e-2

A4.what: 1-D free, Fibonacci: the same (every level admitted, last B >= 27, accumulated <= 1e-2)
A4.prediction: FAIL (development: level 2 not admitted at w <= 6)

A5.what: 1-D free, blocking score = accumulated error x taps (2w+1) C^2 at B = 8 and B = 16 (log interpolation between levels): phi WINS if its score is lower than the best of {2, 3} by >= 20 % at both B, LOSES if higher by >= 20 % at either B or if its chain does not reach B, else TIE
A5.prediction: LOSES (known physics gives no reason for phi; quasi-periodic rules are less local)

A6.what: 1-D soft Coulomb: binding energies of the 3 lowest bound states at the level nearest B = 4 within 1e-2 of the exact base, for each scheme that reaches it; score as A5 at B = 4
A6.prediction: PASS for b = 2, 3; phi as A4

A7.what: 3-D free: each scheme reaches B >= 400 with every level admitted, and the first-order 1s shift |dE|/E_1s at B = 400 (log interpolation) <= 1e-3; score = |dE|/E_1s x taps; same win/lose rule

A8.what: anchor: base bound states vs the fine zig-zag bound states within 1e-2 (binding energies)

fase2.noise_note: step 3 of the loop asks for a fluctuation-dissipation noise term: for ONE wave (no temperature) the discarded detail is a deterministic memory, measured here as the leak 1 - captured weight; FD noise needs a thermal many-body state (phase 4, the droplet): not tested in phase 2 (declared).
